solves: predict losses when two forces wear each other down

tools.name: Lanchester's laws
hypotheses: each force is homogeneous
effectiveness coefficients are constant
the square law needs aimed fire with every unit able to engage
no reinforcement

name: Naval science (General)
solves: estimate the chance of finding something in a large area
predict the outcome of an exchange of salvos

tools.name: Random search formula (Koopman)
tools.does: gives detection probability from effort and area
hypotheses: the target is stationary and equally likely anywhere in the area
search effort is spread at random
the sweep width is known

tools.name: Salvo model (Hughes)
tools.does: predicts losses in an exchange of missile salvos
hypotheses: each side's ships are alike
striking power, defensive power and staying power are known
